RuleDefinition: Same CustomerRef and Amount on the same calendar date; review manually, do not automatically label fraud.
Transactions has an ApprovalID but no matching record exists in Approvals.
Matching Approvals record has ApprovalStatus other than Approved.
TransactionStatus is Success but no SettlementLedger row matches TransactionID.
Transaction Amount differs from SettledAmount for matching TransactionID.
SettlementLedger TransactionID does not exist in Transactions.
